name: 28115 · Mooresville, NC
findings: ZIP 28115 (Mooresville) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28115 (Mooresville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28115 (Mooresville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 56 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
